notes: This focal candidate verifies the existing CHAT-NOTIFICATIONS mute/unmute error contract without expanding its product semantics or claiming OS push transport coverage.

On Web, Android and iOS, the real shared Chat surface started from an exact unmuted Conversation, injected one debug-only or localhost-only failure before the backend mutation, surfaced the common error, cleared progress and restored the exact prior Conversation. The authenticated backend remained unmuted.
The fault hooks remain opt-in and host-bounded: localhost-only on Web, BuildConfig.DEBUG on Android and an explicit XCTest process environment on iOS. Production execution does not activate them.

All three accepted runs removed their owned messages and thread and verified zero physical residue across chat_threads, chat_messages, chat_participants, chat_attachments, chat_message_states, chat_profile_blocks, chat_events and conversation_user_state.

The first iOS attempt failed before XCTest because CoreSimulator did not finish booting. A second attempt identified exhausted VM disk space during app installation. After deleting only regenerable build outputs, the same exact build and product SHA passed; these infrastructure failures are retained in the local source reports and do not represent product failures.

Web and iOS reports bind runtime evidence to d649b43c. The cfacff77 commit only registers the already-passing contract in the fast suites and refreshes capability-matrix hashes, so those platforms were not repeated solely because HEAD changed.

Independent review found that the first Android UI test ignored nullable wait results. The assertion was made mandatory and contract-covered; its first corrective run then failed closed because it expected common copy instead of the Android host localization. The dcd3ce17 run asserted the rendered host error through Compose semantics, re-opened the options menu, proved the restored unmuted action and passed with backend state unchanged and cleanup residue zero. Only Android was recertified because the correction touched only its instrumentation.
The committed reports are sanitized projections. Local paths, screenshots, XCTest output and credential locations were omitted.
This reduction does not certify inbox propagation, APNs/provider transport, device-token acquisition, notification delivery or a global SCR-CHAT GO.
